## Features
- 109 checks
- Five logic difficulties with configurable techniques
- QoL:
	- Ceres skip
	- Fast Elevators
	- Ship Warp
- Gameplay, HUD, palette and font customization
- Experimental Flood Mode, Room FX Shuffle and Party Rando
	- **Experimental modes may create situations outside the supported route logic!**
- PopTracker Pack
